script: Giant kelp can grow up to about 60 centimeters in a single day. It can reach more than 30 meters tall, forming underwater forests. Kelp is not actually a plant, but a type of brown algae. Small gas-filled bulbs keep its blades floating up toward the sunlight. Sea otters help protect kelp forests by eating the sea urchins that feed on kelp.
